metadata.name: Google Groundsource: verified original Florida-region subset
metadata.attribution: Mayo et al. (2026), Groundsource: A Dataset of Flood Events from News. DOI:10.5281/zenodo.18647054.
metadata.coverage_description: All valid original polygon records intersecting the Florida-region bounding box [-88,24,-79,32]; polygons are not clipped or simplified. This is a regional subset, not global coverage.
metadata.field_notes: Original UUID, start/end dates, area_km2 and geocoded polygons retained. Original data has no per-record severity, news article URL, flood depth or calibrated probability. Multiple records may describe the same disaster.
